summary:
Senior Product Designer with 5+ years shipping consumer-facing products across mobile and web, grounded in design systems and cross-platform cohesion. Built and maintained the design system used by 40 product teams at Zalando, cutting component duplication 62%, and drove accessibility audits to WCAG AA compliance across checkout. Track record of end-to-end product design, from a mobile upload flow redesign that lifted completion 24% to brand refreshes spanning web and mobile.</summary>
